reviews.shade: beauty of joseon Red Bean Refreshing Pore Mask 140mL
reviews.text: This Red bean mask is my favourite mask I have ever bought for me…. My oily skin loves this mask it is my second time buying it for me and I am really satisfied with it ! I have really noticed my skin less oily after using it and I am telling you I have very oily skin and no product has ever made a difference to me like this mask has I am soo happy with the results but you do have to be patient and use it regularly to get the best results but seriously I love this product soo much definitely worth buying it 😭 by the way I live in the UAE and I got it delivered to me by olive young I would like to say that this app is amazing I am very satisfied with the delivery time and quality of the products !! As you can see in the 3rd picture I already finished one completely 👍🏻
reviews.zh: 呢個紅豆mask係我買過最鍾意嘅面膜….我嘅油性肌超鍾意呢個面膜，係我第二次買俾自己用，對佢真係好滿意！用完之後真係覺得皮膚冇咁油，我係超油肌嘅人，從來冇一件產品好似呢個面膜咁幫到我，個效果令我超級開心，但你真係要有耐性，定期用先可以得到最好嘅效果，但我真係超鍾意呢件產品，絕對值得買 😭 順帶一提，我住喺 UAE，係經 olive young 送到嚟嘅，我想講呢個app真係超好，對於送貨時間同產品質素我都好滿意！！如你所見，第三張相入面我已經用完一整支 👍🏻

reviews.shade: beauty of joseon Red Bean Refreshing Pore Mask 140mL
reviews.text: Lo use una vez y si me gustó mucho como me dejó la cara, tengo puntos negros y los poros abiertos, lo usé en la noche y a la mañana siguiente vi un cambio pequeño pero notorio. Claro que hay que partir de saber que no es magia, tiene una textura húmeda y no deja seca la cara. Me encantó, lo recomiendo. Tiene un ligero olor dulce, me puse mucho por ser la primera vez creo que con menos producto tendría el mismo efecto.
reviews.zh: 我用咗一次，係，我真係好鍾意用完之後塊面嘅狀態，我有黑頭同埋毛孔粗大，夜晚用咗，第二朝見到有少少但明顯嘅改善。當然要明白佢唔係魔法，質地係濕潤嘅，唔會令塊面變乾。好鍾意，推薦。有少少甜味，因為第一次用所以搽咗好多，我覺得用少啲都會有同樣效果。

reviews.shade: beauty of joseon Red Bean Refreshing Pore Mask 140mL
reviews.text:
If I only had one word to describe this it would be "heavenly" 
I wasn't expecting so much hydration & glow after just one use. The texture of this mask is so rich and smooth, not heavy on the skin at all. There's such a pleasant sent as well. Not a chemical/perfume scent, but a scent of natural essence. There is a gentle exfoliate from the crushed up red beans but not abrasive to the skin. On my second use I applied it not only to my face & neck but on my chest as well. Total game changer! My skin has never looked so bright and beautiful. Of course I am using other KB products but this has brought my glow game to the next level :)
reviews.zh:
如果淨係可以用一個字去形容呢件產品，會係「天堂」
淨係用咗一次就已經有咁好嘅保濕同光澤效果，完全出乎意料。面膜質地好rich好滑，一啲都唔重。仲有好舒服嘅味道。唔係化學品／香水味，而係天然萃取嘅味道。有由磨碎嘅紅豆帶嚟嘅溫和去角質，但係對皮膚唔會造成刺激。第二次用我唔止搽上面同頸，仲搽埋胸口。完全係game changer！我嘅皮膚從來都未試過咁光亮同靚。當然我都有用其他 KB 嘅產品，但係呢件產品已經將我嘅光澤提升到另一個層次 :)

reviews.shade: beauty of joseon Red Bean Refreshing Pore Mask 140mL
reviews.text:
Very cool clay mask!💗
I like the effect after it - the skin is tender, soft, not overdried, without excess sebum and the pores look much better.
Has a pleasant aroma of some sour fruits, a delicate color of a dusty rose. 
Contains scrubbing particles (not in excess). The particles are very delicate, non-traumatic, soft; thanks to them, washing off the mask is much easier, plus there is additional non-traumatic exfoliation of the skin. 
Even if you overdo it - the mask does not dry too much, which usually tightens the skin. It absolutely blew me away, because it's so caring!
The mask is thick, but elastic - it spreads well on the skin, it is easy to spread a thin layer, which makes it extremely economical. 
I think this is a great representative of clay masks and I will buy it again and again - this is my holy grail! 
I highly recommend try it.

Greetings from Ukraine. Thanks to everyone who supports!🫂🙏
Peace, calm and love for whole world 🌎
reviews.zh:
好正嘅泥mask！💗
我鍾意用完之後嘅效果——皮膚變得嫩滑、柔軟，唔會過乾，冇多餘油脂，毛孔望落改善咗好多。
有好似酸酸哋生果嘅香味，乾燥玫瑰嘅淡雅顏色。
含有磨砂粒子（唔會過多）。粒子好幼細，唔傷皮膚，好柔軟；多謝佢哋，洗mask容易咗好多，仲有額外嘅非創傷性去角質。
就算你用多咗——mask都唔會乾到好緊，呢樣真係令我好surprise，因為佢好caring！
Mask質地厚但有彈性——喺皮膚上好易推，好容易搽到薄薄一層，超級慳用。
我覺得呢個係泥mask嘅表表者，我會一買再買——佢係我嘅holy grail！
非常推薦試吓。

問候來自烏克蘭。感謝所有支持嘅人！🫂🙏
願全世界都有和平、安寧同愛 🌎

reviews.shade: beauty of joseon Red Bean Refreshing Pore Mask 140mL
reviews.text: absolutely love this! it has a really nice & creamy texture. it smells just like a strawberry banana smoothie but i love that the fragrance doesn’t irritate my skin as i’m sensitive to fragrances. i noticed it’s great at smoothing and moisturizing my skin when i really need it, i use it once or twice a week & have noticed a significance in reducing the appearance of blackheads around my nose!
reviews.zh: 絕對鍾意！質地真係好正，好creamy。聞落好似士多啤梨香蕉smoothie咁，但我好鍾意佢嘅香味唔會刺激到我塊皮膚，因為我對香料好敏感。我發現當我真係需要嘅時候，佢喺平滑同保濕皮膚方面好出色，我一個禮拜用一至兩次，發現鼻翼附近嘅黑頭明顯減少咗！

reviews.shade: beauty of joseon Red Bean Refreshing Pore Mask 140mL
reviews.text: This is a perfect mask if you have blackheads/whiteheads on nose, chin or wherever on your skin. The texture is really nice on the skin and after using the mask it doesn't dry it out or make it have a tight feeling. It's perfect on oily skin with larger pores and after using it 2x a week I do see a difference with my concerns. It doesn't have a strong fragrance I guess the closest thing it smells too is just red bean but very light. I do like how it comes with a spatula too.
reviews.zh: 如果你鼻、下巴或者皮膚其他位置有黑頭／白頭，呢個係一個完美嘅面膜。質地喺皮膚上面好舒服，用完之後唔會令皮膚變乾或者有繃緊嘅感覺。對油性肌同毛孔粗大嘅皮膚嚟講係完美，一個禮拜用兩次，我真係見到有改善。佢冇強烈嘅香味，我估最接近嘅味道只係好淡嘅紅豆味。我都好鍾意佢跟埋一支刮棒。

reviews.shade: beauty of joseon Red Bean Refreshing Pore Mask 140mL
reviews.text: This product wasn’t terrible but wasn’t great either. It was moisturizing and that’s about it. Did not help with sebum production, pore size, or exfoliation. Find something better.
reviews.zh: 呢件產品唔算差但又唔算好。佢有保濕，就係咁。對控油、毛孔、去角質都冇幫助。搵過第二件啦。

reviews.shade: beauty of joseon Red Bean Refreshing Pore Mask 140mL
reviews.text:
So far I’ve only tried it once, but it left a strong impression from the first time that I can’t not review it already.

First of all, I’m quite sensitive to scents (“unnatural” ones especially) so I was scared at first, I really hoped it didn’t have a very strong unpleasant smell like some other masks I’ve tried. I was happy and surprised when I first opened it though … it smelled like bananas!! Even though there’s no banana in the ingredient list as far as I know, it smells like it, but I’m not mad at it!! Instead, I’m very happy that the scent is not an unpleasant one which could be the reason that would keep me from using it. The mask itself is also very good. 
It has small particulars that act as an exfoliator, but a very gentle one. I’ve tried another brand but they were a little bit too rough, while these ones were very soft! The mask applies and stays easily on the skin while leaving it very soft and without drying it! I can’t recommend it enough!!
reviews.zh:
到目前為止我只係用過一次，但係第一次用已經留下咗好深嘅印象，令我不得不即刻寫評價。

首先，我對香味好敏感（特別係「唔自然」嗰啲），所以一開始我有啲驚，真係好希望佢唔好似我試過嘅其他面膜咁有強烈嘅難聞氣味。第一次打開嘅時候我好開心又驚喜……聞落好似香蕉！！雖然據我所知成份表入面冇香蕉，但係佢就係有香蕉味，但係我唔嬲！！反而我好開心香味唔難聞，呢樣本來可能會令我唔想用。面膜本身都好好。
有細細粒嘅粒子可以當去角質用，但係好溫和。我試過另一個牌子，佢哋嘅粒子太粗，但呢個嘅好柔軟！面膜好容易搽上皮膚同keep住喺皮膚上面，用完之後皮膚好柔軟又唔會乾！我點推薦都唔夠！！
